classification: post-opening dense temporal calibration with frozen finite discriminators; not an unseen holdout
objective: Use Apple's original producer input and metadata-only Metal capture at every nonzero transition sample to locate the effective-origin halo phase transition and distinguish the remaining primary-mesh edge rounding cases without changing candidates after opening the artifact.

openedEvidence.phaseIntervalStatus: open on the lower bound and closed on the upper bound; existing captures have no samples 13 or 14

effectiveOriginRepresentation.scaledLower: L = s * clippedLower using the exact presentation-carrier law and Metal Y inversion
effectiveOriginRepresentation.producerCrop: C = ceil(L) away from the lower clipping boundary; the existing axis-specific integral endpoint convention remains retained
effectiveOriginRepresentation.copyHaloForm: O = alignDown(C - h, 4), where the opened corpus only distinguishes h in {1, 2}

phaseCandidates.name: resampling-ratio-five-fourths
phaseCandidates.law: h = 2 iff q >= 5/4, equivalently s <= 4/5 or k >= 2/5

phaseCandidates.name: rounded-eight-pixel-transition-padding
phaseCandidates.law: h = 2 iff roundNearestAway(8*(1-k)) <= 4, equivalently k >= 7/16 except for the explicit tie rule

phaseCandidates.name: no-single-threshold
phaseCandidates.law: the dense evidence contains a phase-sensitive component inconsistent with every threshold in [0.37773990631103516, 0.4697761535644531]

quad4PrimaryPositionCandidate.residualScope: four one-pixel X-edge residuals at samples 28, 29, and 31; dense sample 30 and all omitted temporal neighbors are discriminators

interpretation.candidateSelection: A phase candidate may be selected only if every phase-sensitive dense component agrees. Failure of all finite candidates is retained as evidence for a non-threshold selector.
interpretation.meshUse: Mesh values are calibration evidence. A recovered predictor still requires a separately frozen unseen-geometry holdout.
